hub_identity.reservation_rule: Create the ticket under registry lock before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: liquid stocks with an upcoming earnings event, positive historical surprise, and a point-in-time low analyst bar where EPS estimate is below last actual EPS may have more executable pre-earnings drift than generic DTE leadership. It uses only free earnings snapshots and OHLCV fields known by the signal date.
acceptance_rule: Gate 1-4 three canonical windows; positive lead only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL window regression, target trades >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and accepted compression comparator is beaten.

prediction.confidence_reason: Uses PIT free earnings snapshots and OHLCV, but nearby pre-earnings and revision lanes were weak. The low-bar EPS estimate-vs-actual field is materially different enough for one replay scout, not for promotion without a shared default-off adapter.

accepted_post_earnings_reference.note: Nearest accepted earnings-event default-off paper adapter. This is a context reference, not a hard gate, because the current test is a direct pre-event positioning source rather than post-event drift.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter that loads the same point-in-time earnings snapshot for the signal date, applies the same days-to-earnings 6-30, positive historical-surprise, and EPS low-bar gates, sector-known liquid stock universe, SPY-relative leadership gates, close-quality gates, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, five-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, accepted compression comparator, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed pre-earnings low-bar leadership bundle failed Gate 4. The result implies the EPS-estimate-vs-last-actual low-bar field did not add enough distinct edge beyond liquid pre-earnings momentum under next-open execution, costs, five-day hold, cooldown, and overlap/concentration controls.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping days-to-earnings windows, low-bar gap, historical surprise threshold, ret20/ret60 relative-strength thresholds, signal-day return, close-location, volume-ratio bounds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially better pre-event expectation evidence such as same-quarter seasonal estimate history, analyst-count breadth, option-implied move with three-window coverage, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not retry by sweeping DTE, low-bar-gap, surprise, ret20/ret60, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.

summary: The pre-earnings low-bar leadership source was rejected; it did not establish a distinct free earnings-calendar/OHLCV candidate-pool edge under the standard three-window protocol.
